subsections.text: BS Computer Science graduate from the University of the Philippines Diliman with a track record of building full-stack applications, leveraging AI-assisted tools for rapid, documented software delivery. Experienced in architecting scalable relational databases and launching end-to-end systems while shipping clean, maintainable code. Proven ability to rapidly adapt to unfamiliar tech stacks on-demand, work in agile teams, communicate with stakeholders, and translate complex requirements to user-facing interfaces.

subsections.title: Full-Stack Developer Intern ( UP FLCD éLaan )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 5 | Client-based Internship, Agile, GitHub, SvelteKit, Supabase
items: Initiated and executed a freelance-style internship with a university department to digitize its booking workflow.
Led the agile development process, facilitating sprint planning, task allocation, and regular client check-ins.
Architected and implemented the core backend system, starting from a normalized PostgreSQL database schema.
Developed dynamic, multi-step multi-role reservation forms using SvelteKit server actions, implementing strict server-side validation to ensure clean data entry before database insertion.
Implemented role-based booking flows and data handling to support multiple user types and booking scenarios.
Rapidly learned and applied Svelte, SvelteKit, and PostgreSQL to deliver a production-ready system within tight timelines.

subsections.title: Web Wrapper with Widgets for iOS & CarPlay ( LiveLyrics )
subsections.subtitle: Sole Developer | React Native, Swift, Objective-C, WidgetKit, Expo, GitHub
items: Directed Gemini 3.6 Flash to rapidly prototype, debug, and ship an end-to-end iOS application within a single week.
Architected a music web wrapper delivering real-time synced lyrics across iOS Home Screen, Lock Screen, and CarPlay widgets.
Orchestrated React Native to WidgetKit IPC using AI-assisted Swift and Objective-C bridges to shared UserDefaults.
Designed real-time DOM lyrics scraping, LRC parsing, and background playback pipelines to maintain functionalities upon lock.
Managed Expo prebuild workflows, target entitlement capabilities, and documentation for physical iPhone deployment.

subsections.title: Virtual Workspace with AI Transcription ( SyncSpace )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 4 | Project Lead, GitHub, Next.js, Supabase, Vercel, Railway
items: Conceptualized and co-developed a virtualized spatial office platform integrated with automated AI meeting transcriptions.
Stepped up as the acting technical lead, managing meeting agendas, sprint goals, and ensuring cross-functional task alignment.
Architected the system's ERD and implemented the Supabase backend infrastructure, handling relational database design, user authentication, and Google OAuth integration.
Developed custom Supabase backend functions and modular endpoint logic to bridge frontend UI states with real-time data.

Owned the project's multi-platform deployment topology, configuring continuous delivery pipelines on Vercel for the frontend and orchestrating independent backend call microservices on Railway hosting environments.

subsections.title: IoT Web Companion Application ( Labuddy )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 6 | Backend Lead, IoT Integration, Product Pitch, GitHub, Supabase, React Native
items: Led backend development for an IoT-enabled laundry sorting system with a real-time web companion app.
Designed and implemented a scalable database using Supabase and PostgreSQL to manage device data and user accounts.
Engineered the Supabase data access layer, writing optimized database functions and real-time listeners to instantly sync asynchronous laundry hardware signals with the React Native client state.
Developed frontend forms and iterated on UX flow to ensure intuitive interaction between users and IoT hardware.
Presented the system in a Dragon's Den-style pitch, communicating technical feasibility and product value to evaluators.

items.Backend & Databases: Supabase, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Playwright, Authentication, REST & RPC API Integration
